high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from a page named "UniquE 😎 FactSs." The post includes a question answered by Abhilash Singh on July 31. The question is partially visible but mentions someone who became a fake spiritual guru and ended up with real followers who called him "the living embodiment of the divine." Below the question, there is an image of a woman with long, dark hair wearing a pink top. She has a tattoo on her left shoulder that features intricate designs, including what appears to be a Buddha figure.
